question: Is an OpenCode agent with no `permission` map offered every tool of a connected MCP server, where an agent whose map is only `"*": "deny"` with `external_directory` and `doom_loop` restated is offered none?

assertion.projection: def governed: [.[] | select(any(.messages[]?; .role == "system" and (.content | tostring | contains("AGENTSPEC-PROBE-MARKER-OCMCPU1"))))]; def mcp: governed | map([.tools[]?.function.name | select(startswith("fx_"))] | sort) | unique | if length == 0 then "arm-had-no-governed-request" elif length == 1 then .[0] else {inconsistent: .} end; {no_map: (.no_map | mcp), deny_all: (.deny_all | mcp)}
